styles.name: Storm grey waist apron with centre pocket and self fabric ties — Ciao Bella logo in pale green

fabrics: Storm grey 6 oz 65% recycled polyester / 35% BCI cotton 200 gsm (Tiajo) — rating 0.50 m
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S STORM GREY 09963 — cost per metre
Tibard pre-printed care label, set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn: 60° wash · 2 dot iron · tumble dry low · no bleach · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
mfg: Double turn all round and topstitch 12 mm. Insert the care label 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn.
Self fabric ties: bag out the ends and edgestitch one side. Set into the top of the side seam with the fold of the tie level with the top edge.
Fold back the ties and stitch down to secure, to the width of the tie.
Double turn the pocket hem and topstitch 12 mm.
Edgestitch the pocket down. Set the pocket centrally within the front, top of the pocket 12.5 cm down from the top edge.
V tack the top corners of the pocket.
styles.brandPlace: Ciao Bella logo, 8 cm, in pale green thread 1900, set to the left front hem as worn: centre of the logo 8 cm up from the hem and 17 cm in from the left side seam as worn. Embroidery set after make-up.

trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
mfg: Double turn the two long sides using the folder and topstitch 6 mm.
Double turn the two shorter sides by hand and topstitch 6 mm.

styles.name: Wagamama red skull cap, revised larger fit — mesh oval crown, velcro adjustable, Wagamama logo in white
styles.desc: SKULL HAT · Revised larger fit · Mesh oval crown · Longer velcro fastened tab at centre back for adjustment, revised cut length of hook and loop velcro · Tibard tax tab right side of the hat as worn · Wagamama logo in white, front off-centre to the right as worn
fabrics: Red 65% polyester / 35% cotton 200 gsm X133 colour 111 (Tiajo) — rating 0.12 m
Red 100% polyester mesh (Philip Whitfield & Sons) — oval crown, rating 0.04 m
trims: Black 16 mm hook velcro, cut at 11 cm (set to the back of the hat, end level with the back split).
Black 16 mm loop velcro, cut at 7 cm (on the tab). Sage holds the hook only; no code for the loop yet.
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S RED 03860 — cost per metre. The sheet allows 03855 until stocks run out, then 03822.

Tibard tax tab set to the right side of the hat as worn. Stitch in white thread on top and spool in thread to match the hat. Set with the green check of the label to the top. Set the edge of the label to the bottom edge of the hat and 1 cm from the secured end of the tab. Fold in one side of the label to neaten. Edgestitch all round.

Tibard printed care label, set into the centre back crown. Composition to state 65% recycled polyester 35% organic cotton; mesh 100% polyester · 60° wash · 2 dot iron · tumble dry · do not bleach · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
mfg: Make the velcro tab. Set the loop velcro 12 mm from the end of the tab edge, level with the centre fold of the tab. Edgestitch the loop velcro to the tab. Bag out both ends. Edgestitch the lower edge of the tab to close the tab.
Join the centre back seam panel and notch into the end of the seam. Bag out the slits.
Stitch along the top edge to secure the plies together and set the care label / batch label.
5 thread join the crown to the panel. Notch = centre front and centre back.

Set the velcro tab to the back of the hat, right side as worn. Set the tab so there is a 3.5 cm gap between the end of the loop velcro and the base of the hat split, to allow for adjustment. Edgestitch all round the tab to secure it to the hat.
Edgestitch the back split.
Set the hook velcro to the back of the hat. End of the velcro to be level with the back split. Edgestitch all round the velcro.

Set the Tibard tax tab: white thread on top, spool to match the hat, green check to the top of the label, edge of the label to the bottom edge of the hat and 1 cm from the secured end of the tab. Fold in the side of the label to neaten. Edgestitch all round.
fin: Bartack horizontal at the top of the split.
styles.brandPlace: Wagamama logo 3 cm in white (the star also in white), front off-centre to the right side of the hat as worn: centre of the logo 2.2 cm up from the bottom edge of the hat. Logo set after make-up.
styles.note: Stock works order 1156 for WAGHTM016007, Gail, issued 14/9/26, required 9/10/26 for 10 (JH created 25/09/23 SR1150; created for trial JH 3/10/23; created for SR1158 slightly smaller than SR1150 jh 16/10/23; approved for bulk 23/10/23 IM; amended to Tiajo red fabric colour 111 JH RCR449 12/1/26; composition label 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton JH 26/1/26, as GW wants every care label to read the same; photo for the embroidery position JH 22/1/26; fabric code PC2007 to PC2X13307 JH 2/3/26). Rating 0.12 m, the same as All Costings; the mesh crown at 0.04 m. The larger WAG0160M fit is 60 cm round against the 57 cm of the HT0160NEW hat. Sage sells the hat in white 01, black 03, navy 15, bottle 24 and grey 64 as well; only the red sheet is on file. The sheet's sketch is in works-orders/WAGHTM016007-Wagamama.xlsx.

styles.name: Black denim retail waist apron, full width pocket divided into three, zip pocket, eyelets and D ring loops — Hickory's 5 star logo in gold
styles.desc: RETAIL WAIST APRON · Retail width with a full width pocket divided into three · Zip pocket set to the left front as worn · Eyelets at the waist for the self fabric waist ties · D ring loops at each side, set into the top of the pocket hem stitching · Contrast gold topstitching · Black OH logo'd towel loop · Hickory's 5 star logo in gold above the wide pocket, right side as worn
fabrics: Black denim 100% cotton Art Murray 315 gsm (P and R fabrics) — rating 0.53 m
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S GOLD 02362 for all stitching on the denim — cost per metre (Sage holds the shade as the 40's gold)
Set into the right side seam as worn, 4 cm down from the top edge.
Oliver Harvey wash instructions under the woven label: 100% cotton · 50° wash · no bleach · 2 dot iron · no tumble dry · dry clean.
Black Oliver Harvey logo'd tape, cut 39 cm, Oliver Harvey to read from top to bottom. Sage holds black OH tape as the non tangle tie CMP-OH-NTT-25-03: use that code if it is the same tape.
18 cm (7") black zip with antique brass metal teeth, MGKBC56C/7/18, 1 per apron. No Sage code for the metal zip (Sage holds spiral zips only).
Set with a self fabric loop and inserted into the top of the pocket hem topstitching, 1 at each side: 2 per apron.
010B/7P - 011B antique brass invert nipple rivet and post. Set one at the top of each stitch line of the wide pocket: 2 per apron. No Sage code on the sheet.
30E/R AB 30 mm eyelet. Set so the centre of the eyelet is 3 cm from the finished top edge and 3 cm in from the finished side seam: 2 per apron.
The ring for each 30 mm eyelet: 2 per apron.
mfg: Make the waist ties: bag out both ends and topstitch the long edge.
Set the eyelet re-inforcement pieces.

Set the towel loop: cut at 39 cm and fold in half. Set to the armhole curve 10 cm from the side seam cut edge, left side as worn, Oliver Harvey to read down. Stitch down the towel loop to follow the armhole stitching.

Make the zip pocket. Set the pocket bag to the apron with the right sides of the fabrics together, use the marker for the position. Steck holes to be in line with the notch in the side seam; steck hole to the cut side seam 11 cm. Stitch the box opening for the zip: use the steck holes for the centre of the box and stitch 1 cm past the steck hole, a 3 stitch wide (1 cm) box. The opening is 3 cm down from the cut edge and central within the width of the pocket bag.

Cut the opening for the zip. Press the opening before topstitching the zip, or edgestitch the inside long edges to help the seams roll. Set the zip (when closed the puller is to the left side seam as worn). Edgestitch all round. Set a second row of twin needle stitching to the sides and bottom of the pocket. Close the pocket bags: the lower bag extends 2 cm (as notched) past the top bag to neaten the top edge; edges enclosed on the inside. Double turn the top edge of the pocket. Twin needle stitch the top of the zip opening, stitching through the pocket bag when topstitching the top of the pocket.
Set the pocket hem: double turn 1 cm and twin needle stitch. To reduce bulk at the ends start the double turn 1.5 cm from each end (nick into the turning to let it lie flat).

Set the wide pocket to the hem of the apron with the wrong sides uppermost, 1 cm seam. Edgestitch the seam allowance onto the apron to ease the fold of the pocket at the hem. Fold the pocket up onto the front and tack up the sides.
Double turn and topstitch 12 mm the sides and top. Set the labels in the right side seam as worn, 4 cm down from the finished top edge.
Make the D ring loops: fold over at the notch each side to finish to the width of the D ring. Edgestitch both long edges.

Set a D ring to each end of the wide pocket mouth: insert one end of the loop into the pocket hem and stitch down the pocket hem to the width of the D ring. Fold the loop over and insert the other end. Topstitch down following the bottom row of twin needle stitching.
Twin needle pocket stitch lines: from each side as worn set the pocket stitch line 18.5 cm measured from the finished side seam to the first row of twin needle stitching.

After the eyelets are set the apron comes back to the machinist for the waist ties: set the tie through the eyelet 4 cm and stitch down to secure, join on the inside as worn. Box stitch 2 stitch wide to the width of the strap.
fin: Set the rivets to the top of the stitch lines on the wide pocket: 2 in total.
Set the eyelets: centre of the eyelet 3 cm in from the side seam and 3 cm down from the top. The apron goes back to the machinist for the waist ties to be set.
Bartack the end of each D ring loop to re-inforce the pocket: 2 bartacks.
Trim, press, fold and wrap in Oliver Harvey tissue. Set the product sticker to the tissue and set into a bag.
styles.brandPlace: Hickory's 5 star logo (20 cm) in gold thread, set above the wide pocket, right side as worn: centre of the embroidery in line with the twin needle pocket divide and level with the zip pocket.
styles.note: Works order OHHICAPP062803DEN for Hickory's, EMB-HIC 0816, Gail, issued 21/8/26, required 23/9/26 for 30 (JH created 23/1/17 based on the waist version of SR533; waist tie amended to self fabric denim JH 24/1/17; amended to the shorter length JH 11/4/17; code amended re CW JH 2/5/19; fabric rating added jh 23/3/26). Rating 0.53 m on the sheet; All Costings carries 0.55 m and the lay plan's marker 0628001 is 2.59 m for 5 (0.518 m). The sheet's second tab is the 2017 pattern request to Alan: variant 0628 from the APP0617 variant 0617ELET block, with the wide pocket, zip pocket and D ring loops from OHAP0534 variant 0627. The logo artwork is not on the sheet; its sketch of the apron is in works-orders/OHHICAPP062803DEN-Hickorys.xlsx.

styles.name: Navy bib apron with one mitred hip pocket and pen pocket, self fabric ties and neck strap with leather loop — Pilot Light label
styles.desc: BIB APRON · 1 x mitred hip pocket, right side as worn · Pen pocket on the bib, left side as worn, with the OH tax tab · Self fabric adjustable neck strap with leather loop · Self fabric waist ties, box stitched to secure · Pilot Light woven label at the left hem as worn · Cut the neck strap 86 cm long
styles.lectra: APP0630, variant PILOTLGT — cut the leather strap 2.5 cm x 14 cm, 1 per apron
fabrics: Navy 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM303 (Tiajo) — rating 0.70 m
Leather trim: the cutting room cuts 1 strap per apron, 2.5 cm wide x 14 cm long — no rating on the sheet
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S NAVY 07935 — cost per metre
Coats Epic 80's black on top and navy on the spool for edgestitching the Pilot Light label (top thread to match the label, spool to match the apron).
Oliver Harvey woven label, set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn.
Oliver Harvey care label: 100% organic cotton · 40° wash · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not bleach · low tumble dry. Set 4 cm down from the top of the finished right side seam as worn.
Additional label stating "REMOVE LEATHER TRIM BEFORE WASH", printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape, set with the OH care label.
25 mm SAB BUCK AB triglide x 1 (New Lace). No Sage code on the sheet.
25 mm rectangular ring x 1 (New Lace). No Sage code on the sheet.
Set to the left side of the pen pocket as worn, level with the top edge.

Woven Pilot Light label set to the bottom left-hand corner of the apron: side of the label 2 cm in from the side seam and bottom of the label 2 cm up from the finished hem. Edgestitch in thread to match the label colour on top and the apron on the spool. No Sage code on the sheet.

2 x female studs set to the leather strap, 2 x male studs set to the bib apron; use the markers. The sheet gives no stud quality: the OHAPP0786 sheets name New Lace 050B/C and 050B/D, which Sage holds as CMP-STD-CAP-050-929 / CMP-STD-SOC-050-929.
mfg: Cutting: cut the neck strap 86 cm long. Cut the leather strap 2.5 cm x 14 cm, 1 per apron.
Set the bib facing. Top of the bib 6 mm topstitched. Fold in 10 mm to neaten the lower edge; edgestitch the lower edge of the facing, which forms 5.5 cm topstitching to the front.
Armhole double turned, topstitching to finish 6 mm from the edge.
Hem double turned, topstitching to finish 12 mm from the edge.
Sides double turned, topstitching to finish 12 mm from the edge. Note: neaten the armholes before the side seam is neatened.
Set the pocket hem: double turn 1 + 2 cm and topstitch 1.8 cm.
Set the pocket to the apron: base of the pocket 24 cm up from the finished hem and 5 cm in from the finished right side seam. Edgestitch in position. Stitch a triangle tack to the top of the pocket.

Set the pen pocket to the left side of the bib as worn: top edge 8 cm down from the top of the finished bib and 3.5 cm in from the finished armhole. Edgestitch 3 sides. Set the Oliver Harvey tax tab level with the top of the pocket, left side of the pocket as worn.
Single stitch line down the centre of the pen pocket.

Make the neck strap: fold in half and enclose the raw edges, to finish 25 mm wide to fit the sliders. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam. Thread through the slider and secure to the slider. Insert the bar and stitch down to form a loop.

Set the neck strap to the left side of the bib top as worn: end of the strap level with the bib topstitching and side of the strap level with the 6 mm topstitch of the apron. Cross and box stitch to the width of the strap.
Make the waist ties: bag out both ends, fold in half and enclose the raw edges. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam.
Set the waist tie to the side seam: 3 cm over onto the apron with the top edge of the tie level with the armhole. Box and cross stitch into position, to the width of the strap by 3 cm.

Set the Pilot Light woven label to the bottom left-hand corner of the apron: side of the label 2 cm in from the left side seam and bottom of the label 2 cm up from the finished hem. Edgestitch all round, top thread to match the label and spool to match the apron.
fin: Set 2 female studs to the leather loop, use the marker. Set 2 male studs to the apron, use the marker. Studs on the bib: the top stud faces to the back and the bottom stud faces to the front.
Bartack the top of the pen pocket x 3.
Check, trim, press and fold. Tissue and set the product label.
styles.tol: Across bib ± 0.5 cm · Neck strap width ± 0.5 cm · Widths and lengths ± 1.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: Pilot Light woven label (customer's own, sewn on, no embroidery) at the bottom left-hand corner as worn: side of the label 2 cm in from the side seam, bottom of the label 2 cm up from the finished hem.
styles.note: Works order 1084 for OHAPP063015HP1S, Pilot Light, Gail, issued 8/9/26, required 29/9/26 for 12 (JH created for SR856 12/12/19; approved for bulk 2/1/20; fabric amended to Tiajo X149ECO and care label changed JH 31/3/25). Rating 0.70 m, the same as All Costings; the lay plan's marker AP0630100 is 2.6 m for 4 (0.65 m). The leather strap has no rating on the sheet. No embroidery: the branding is the woven Pilot Light label. The sheet's sketch, the label and its placement are in works-orders/OHAPP063015HP1S-PilotLight.xlsx.
